questions.question: Amit's present age is 5/4 of his age at time of his sister's marriage. If his sister's marriage happened 5 years ago and his father's age was twice of Amit's age at that time, then what is his father's present age (in years)?
questions.solution:
Let Amit's age at the time of his sister’s marriage be X.

So his present age will be 5X/4.

Also, Amit's age 5 years ago = X; so, present age will be 5 + X.

According to question,

5X/4 = 5 + X;

5X = 20 + 4X;

X = 20

His father's age at the time of marriage = 2X

so, present age of his father = 2X + 5= 2 × 20 + 5 = 45 years.

Hence, present age of father is 45 years.

questions.question: Present age of a father is 3 times that of his son. After 10 years the son’s age will be 5 times of Raman’s present age. If Raman celebrated his third birthday 2 years ago, then what is the present age (in years) of father?
questions.solution:
Present age of a father is 3 times that of his son, let son’s age be ‘X’

Then, father’s age will be ‘3X’.

Raman celebrated his 3rd birthday 2 years ago,

That means his present age is 3 + 2 = 5 years

After 10 years the son’s age will be 5 times of Raman’s present age

Hence, son’s age after 10 years = 5 × 5 = 25

Hence, son’s present age = 25 - 10 = 15

Hence, present age of father (3X) = 3 × 15 = 45

Hence, father’s present age is 45 years.

Prime factorization of 24 = 2³ × 3¹

⇒ 2 × 12 = 24

⇒ 3 × 8 = 24

⇒ 4 × 6 = 24

⇒ The positive factors of 24 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, and 24.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• "Going" is the gerund form required after the preposition "in".
 
• Using "no sense in going there" makes the sentence clearer and more understandable.
 
• "No sense in [verb+ing]" is a commonly accepted phrase in the English language, making it more familiar to readers.
 
• Given the context of professors being on strike, using "no sense in going there" properly conveys the futility of going to the university.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**
